title: Accounts Assistant
description:
You're the person who spots when an invoice doesn't look right - and wants to find out why.

If that sounds familiar, I'm recruiting for a growing business where that approach will be valued.

This is a role for someone who enjoys sales and purchase ledger work and takes pride in getting the detail right. You'll get to understand what the business delivers, work closely with colleagues across the team and make sure the paperwork reflects what's actually happened.

There's plenty to keep you interested. Different customers have different billing requirements, so you'll need to stay organised, ask questions and investigate anything that doesn't add up.

What you'll be doing

The role is mainly sales ledger, alongside purchase ledger responsibilities and some support with customer payments. You'll be:
- Preparing and checking sales invoices against supporting information.
- Making sure customers receive the documents they need, in the format they require.
- Working with operational colleagues to resolve missing information and billing queries.
- Processing supplier invoices and investigating discrepancies.
- Supporting supplier statement reconciliations and keeping ledger records accurate.
- Helping with payment queries and credit control cover when needed.

Who I'd like to speak to

You'll have practical experience in sales ledger, purchase ledger or a broader accounts administration role, with a sound understanding of how the ledgers work.

Just as important is how you approach the job. You ask questions, follow things through and pay attention to what's happening around you. If something looks unusual, you check it before moving on.

You'll be comfortable with a busy workload, confident learning systems and happy speaking with colleagues, customers and suppliers to get an answer.

An accountancy qualification isn't essential. Relevant experience, accuracy and a willingness to learn the business will carry more weight.

Why consider it?

You'll join a close-knit team in a growing business where your contribution is easy to see. There's room to build your knowledge, put forward ideas and become someone colleagues trust to keep things running properly.

The position is focused on ledger work, so it should suit someone who enjoys that area of finance and wants to take real ownership of it.

If you'd like to hear more, please send your CV to Jason at Abbeygate Search or get in touch for an initial conversation.

Are you an experienced Accounts Payable professional who enjoys getting stuck into a challenge, resolving complex queries and bringing order to an overloaded purchase ledger?

We are working with a leading agile and forward-thinking organisation who are looking for an experienced Interim Accounts Payable Specialist to join their finance team on an immediate basis, with the assignment running until the end of April 2027.

This is very much a hands-on AP clean-up role, with a key focus on tackling an existing backlog, reviewing historic transactions, clearing aged items and resolving outstanding supplier queries.

You'll play an important role in getting the purchase ledger back up to date, ensuring outstanding issues are investigated and accounts are brought back into good order.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives on making a tangible difference, is confident taking ownership of a busy ledger and has previous experience of successfully clearing AP backlogs.

The Role

Working as part of the finance team, you will take ownership of a range of outstanding Accounts Payable activities, with a particular emphasis on historic ledger clean-up and query resolution.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Working through a substantial backlog of outstanding supplier invoices and purchase ledger transactions.
- Reviewing and clearing aged items and historic balances on supplier accounts.
- Investigating discrepancies, unmatched invoices, payment issues and outstanding queries.
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving long-standing differences.
- Proactively contacting suppliers and internal departments to obtain information and drive queries through to resolution.
- Identifying and correcting ledger issues to ensure supplier accounts are accurate and up to date.
- Prioritising outstanding work, managing competing demands and making measurable progress against the backlog.
- Providing general AP support as required to ensure the smooth running of the function.

About You

We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to get stuck into a busy and potentially untidy purchase ledger.

Ideally, you will have:
- Strong, demonstrable experience within Accounts Payable / Purchase Ledger.
- Previous experience of clearing significant AP backlogs or undertaking ledger clean-up projects.
- Confidence investigating historic transactions, aged balances and long-standing supplier queries.
- Strong supplier statement reconciliation and query resolution skills.
- A proactive, methodical approach, with the ability to investigate issues rather than simply process invoices.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work through high volumes of outstanding work efficiently.
- The confidence to take ownership, use your initiative and make an immediate impact.
- Availability to start immediately and commit to the assignment through to April 2027.

What's on Offer?
- £17-£19 per hour (inc. Holiday uplift) depending on experience.
- 40-hour working week - 8:30am - 5:30pm
- Hybrid working - four days in the office and one day from home.
- Immediate start available.
- A long-term interim assignment through to the end of April 2027.
- The opportunity to make a real difference by helping a finance function get its AP ledger back on track.

Interested?
If you're an experienced Accounts Payable professional who knows their way around a purchase ledger, enjoys solving problems and has a proven ability to clear backlogs and get supplier accounts back into shape, we'd love to hear from you.

We're particularly keen to hear from candidates who are immediately available and can hit the ground running.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Location: Wellingborough

Focus: Credit Control & Purchase Ledger

The Role

We are looking for a proactive and organised Finance Assistant to join a busy finance team based in Wellingborough. This is a varied role with a strong emphasis on credit control and managing outstanding customer accounts, alongside some purchase ledger responsibilities.

The successful candidate will be confident communicating with customers, resolving invoice queries and ensuring payments are received in a timely manner. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous finance experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and taking ownership of their workload.

Key Responsibilities
Credit Control
- Proactively manage and chase outstanding customer payments via telephone and email.
- Monitor aged debt reports and ensure overdue accounts are followed up promptly.

- Previous experience in a finance assistant, credit control or accounts receivable role.
- Strong experience in credit control, including chasing debt and resolving customer queries.

- Confident communicator with a professional and persistent approach to payment collection.
- Strong attention to detail and good numerical skills.
- Well organised, able to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Comfortable using Excel and finance/accounting systems.
- A proactive team player who can also work independently.

Salary & Benefits

JM&Co. Recruitment is working with an established local business looking to recruit an experienced and organised Part-Time Finance Officer to support its day-to-day financial operations and wider business administration.

This is a varied, hands-on position that would suit someone with a strong background in accounts or finance administration who enjoys taking ownership of their work, maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the smooth running of a business.

The role combines traditional accounts responsibilities with financial reporting and general administrative support, offering plenty of variety and the opportunity to become a valued part of the business.

Finance & Accounts

Maintaining accurate financial records, ledgers and accounting documentation.

Processing purchase and sales invoices, expenses, payments and receipts.

Experience using Xero accounting software.

A proactive, practical approach and the confidence to work independently.

description:
Payroll Co-ordinator - Permanent

Further information is available upon application, prior to interview.

The Opportunity

We are recruiting for an experienced Payroll Co-ordinator to join an established and busy payroll function within a growing organisation.

This is a hands-on payroll position, with responsibility for supporting the accurate and timely processing of multiple monthly payrolls, alongside associated expenses, payroll administration and employee benefits.

Working as part of a wider HR function, you will play an important role in maintaining accurate employee and payroll records, ensuring deadlines are consistently met and providing support with payroll-related queries.

The ideal candidate will have at 2-3 years' experience working within a payroll environment, be confident working with payroll systems and have a strong understanding of payroll processes, legislation and data accuracy.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the accurate and timely processing of monthly payroll runs, ensuring all information is checked and processed within strict deadlines.
- Support the processing of monthly expenses, ensuring accurate calculations and payments.
- Maintain and update employee payroll records, ensuring all information is accurate, complete and up to date.
- Carry out regular data entry, data cleansing and integrity checks across payroll systems.
- Respond to payroll-related queries from employees and internal colleagues, providing guidance and escalating more complex matters where necessary.
- Ensure payroll changes, adjustments and employee information are processed accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Prepare and process payroll costing information for the Finance team.
- Support the administration of employee benefits.
- Assist with annual salary review calculations, checking information and ensuring changes are accurately reflected.
- Work closely with colleagues across Finance, Payroll & HR to identify and resolve discrepancies, improve processes and maintain accurate records.
- Ensure all payroll activities are carried out in line with relevant legislation, GDPR and internal data protection requirements.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with a solid background in payroll who can confidently support a busy payroll operation and take responsibility for ensuring work is completed accurately and on time.

You will ideally demonstrate:
- A 2-3 years' of experience working within a payroll environment.
- A good understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and associated administration.
- Knowledge of payroll legislation, including PAYE, National Insurance and pension contributions.
- Experience using payroll systems.
- Strong Excel and spreadsheet skills.
- Experience handling payroll queries and communicating with employees and internal stakeholders.
- A good understanding of confidentiality, GDPR and the importance of handling sensitive payroll information.
- Excellent attention to detail, accuracy and organisation.

Experience & Qualifications
- A recognised payroll qualification, although not essential.
- Experience handling employee benefits.
- Strong knowledge of Excel functions, including pivot tables.
- Experience supporting annual salary reviews and payroll costing exercises.
- Previous experience working with larger or multi-site payroll operations.

Personal Attributes

The successful candidate will be:
- Confident and proactive: Someone who is comfortable taking ownership of their responsibilities and managing expectations.
- Highly organised: Able to prioritise workloads and work to multiple payroll deadlines.
- Accurate and methodical: Takes pride in getting things right and spotting discrepancies.
- Strong-minded: Confident enough to challenge information, raise issues and ensure deadlines are maintained.
- A good communicator: Comfortable dealing with payroll queries and working with colleagues across different departments.
- A team player: Willing to support the wider team and contribute towards improving processes.

This is an opportunity for an experienced Payroll Co-ordinator/Administrator who enjoys the detail and responsibility that comes with payroll processing.

Someone who can hit the ground running, has a good understanding of payroll fundamentals and is confident working within a deadline-driven environment.

You don't necessarily need to hold a formal payroll qualification, but you must have solid practical payroll experience, a good understanding of payroll legislation and the confidence to manage your workload independently.

title: Polish Speaking Accounts Assistant
description:
As a Polish Speaking Accounts Assistant in Northampton, you will handle day-to-day accounting tasks that help keep financial records accurate within the Transport & Distribution industry. You will work as part of the Accounting & Finance department, using Polish language skills to support clear communication and reliable record keeping.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Transport & Distribution industry in Northampton. Our client is happy to offer hybrid working after initial settling in.

Description
- Maintain accurate financial records and update accounting information in a timely way.
- Process routine finance documents to support the smooth running of the Accounting & Finance department.
- Look after the purchase and sales ledger tasks.
- Daily banking.
- Communicate in Polish where needed to clarify financial information and resolve routine queries.
- Check financial data for accuracy and raise any discrepancies for review.
- Organise supporting documents so records are easy to find and use.
- Help prepare information needed for regular finance reporting.
- Work with colleagues to keep accounting tasks on track and records up to date.
- Follow established finance processes to maintain consistent documentation.

Profile

A successful 'Polish Speaking Accounts Assistant' should have:
- Polish language skills for clear written and spoken communication.
- Experience completing routine accounting and finance administration tasks.
- A careful approach to checking figures, records and supporting documents.
- Confidence handling financial information accurately and confidentially.
- The ability to organise documents and maintain clear financial records.
- Experience responding to routine finance queries in a helpful, professional way.

Job Offer
- Permanent contract.
- Hybrid working available after initial settling in period, up to 2 days per week working from home.
- Salary of £30,000 to £36,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- Based in Northampton.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.
